Moumita Das

Senior Project Manager | Technical Program Manager | PMP® | Agile Delivery | Enterprise Transformation

Kolkata/Bangalore, India

mou2mita@gmail.com | +91- 8904050020 | www.linkedin.com/in/moumita-das-1578b476

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

PMP-certified Senior Project Manager with 15+ years of IT experience, including 9+ years leading Project and Program Management initiatives. Extensive experience delivering enterprise technology transformation programs within the Banking & Financial Services domain. Experienced in partnering with Engineering, DevOps, QA, Infrastructure, and Product teams to deliver scalable technology solutions using Agile and hybrid delivery methodologies. Expertise in Agile delivery, PMO governance, portfolio management, executive reporting, stakeholder engagement, project financial management, and cross-functional leadership. Proven track record of delivering enterprise transformation initiatives that improve operational efficiency, governance maturity, delivery predictability, and business value across globally distributed teams

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

15+ years of IT experience, including 9+ years leading Project & Program Management across Banking & Financial Services.

PMP® Certified and Certified Scrum Master, specializing in Agile delivery, PMO governance, and enterprise



transformation. Led 20+ member globally distributed teams across the US, UK, and APAC, delivering complex technology programs.

Managed 40+ business and technology stakeholders, driving executive alignment and successful program execution.

Delivered 15 production releases per quarter through Agile delivery while maintaining governance and quality standards.

Reduced deployment time by 75% (2 hours to 30 minutes) through CI/CD transformation, contributing to approximately USD 1.5M annual program savings.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Portfolio Management Executive Reporting • • Governance Reporting • Release Management • Delivery Management • Agile Coaching & Scrum Mastery

Risk Management • Client & Stakeholder Management



Enterprise Systems Delivery

Vendor Management • Resource Planning • Agile Transformation • Continuous Improvement • Technology Transformation • Budget Forecasting • Capacity Planning

Change Management • Cross-functional Leadership SDLC

• Project Financial Management

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Project Management Jira | Confluence | MS Project | Miro | MS Visio

Reporting & Analytics Power BI | Excel Enterprise Platforms ServiceNow | Harness | Microsoft Clarity

Methodologies: Agile|Scrum|Waterfall|Hybrid Cloud AWS (Basic) AI Productivity Microsoft Copilot | ChatGPT

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Sr. Project Manager | FIS Global | Dec 2019 – Present



Led end-to-end delivery of enterprise technology transformation programs, managing two Agile teams and delivering 15 production releases per quarter while tracking key delivery KPIs, including release cadence, sprint predictability, and deployment success.

Spearheaded CI/CD transformation and Harness migration, reducing application deployment time by 75% (2 hours to 30 minutes), improving deployment reliability, and contributing to estimated annual operational savings of USD 1.5 million across the program.

Managed cross-functional teams of 20+ members and 40+ global business and technology stakeholders across the US, UK, and APAC, driving Agile governance, stakeholder alignment, and delivery excellence.

Established executive governance through dashboards, KPI reporting, status reports, and steering committee presentations, enabling data-driven decision-making and proactive risk management. Led risk, issue, dependency, and change management across multiple workstreams, ensuring timely identification, escalation, mitigation, and successful project delivery.



Drove Agile transformation initiatives, facilitating PI Planning, Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and fostering collaboration across Product, Development, QA, and Operations teams.

Streamlined ServiceNow and MIR3 integration and standardized release processes, improving incident



response, operational efficiency, and enterprise release governance. Leveraged Microsoft Copilot and ChatGPT to automate project documentation, meeting summaries, executive communications, and reporting, improving team productivity and communication efficiency

Business Process Lead | TCS | Jun 2016 – Nov 2019

Managed end-to-end infrastructure projects for JP Morgan, overseeing scope, schedule, risks and stakeholder communications.

Prepared weekly governance reports for leadership overseeing 10+ quarterly migration across globally distributed teams Supported project financial monitoring, resource allocation, and schedule tracking.

• Coordinated project risks, issues, dependencies, and change requests across multiple workstreams. • • • Worked closely with global stakeholders to ensure project reporting accuracy and timely delivery. Led cross-functional global teams of 10+ members delivering infrastructure transformation initiatives. Implemented PMO governance processes improving project visibility and reducing escalation rates.

Sr. Software Engineer | Birlasoft | Mar 2010 – Nov 2014

Oversaw data migration from SQL Server to Oracle 9i for GE Asset Management ( invoice resolution, PO placements, transactional error resolution, receiving issues)

Conducted UAT and manual testing for ClearOrbit/O2S project, ensuring supplier compliance tracking. • • Led a team of 16 engineers, managing requirements, client calls, and technical specifications. Supported procurement operations including invoice resolution, purchase order processing, transactional error management, and receiving issue resolution for enterprise customers

Collaborated with business users, suppliers, and cross-functional teams to ensure timely resolution of procurement and supply-chain related transactions

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

Bachelor of Technology (Electronics & Communication Engineering) West Bengal University of Technology | 2008

PMP Certified (2025) • •

Scrum Master Certified SRE Foundation & Practitioner Certified

ADDITIONAL ACHIEVEMENTS

Published whitepaper: "Migrating New Tool in a Matrix Organization," adopted as a reference framework for enterprise migration initiatives. Languages: English, Hindi, Bengali
